label: Mother with children gets pregnant (husband, new partner or lover)
description: Adult mothers who already have children and become pregnant in a passionate relationship with a husband, new partner or lover. Adults only; teen pregnancies and anything involving minors are excluded. The source adds 18 new titles and tags or enriches 66 existing cards with pregnant-at-the-end, kids-together and earlier-children fields. Pregnant by the end follows the catalog convention: 'yes' means she becomes pregnant in the story; the note names the father and the outcome (birth, miscarriage, stillbirth, abortion, or not stated).
